reviews.comment: Alvarado was great, he made a tough course as bearable as possible and always worked with us to make sure we understood the material as well as help us depending on circumstances. He helped us with generous extra credit due to the final exam being absolutely horrendous. Also a super nice guy to sit and talk with about whatever.

I had this professor for engr 102 and 216, and he was amazing. He explains all the topics in a way that you can understand. He genuinely cares for all of his students and is very understanding. I recommend this professor to everyone.

Professor Alvarado is my favorite professor I've ever had. He is very passionate about engineering and never hesitates to extend a deadline when his students are struggling. He tells lots of stories from his experience in the industry. He is very understanding when something personal happens and is always there to listen to you rant. Very nice guy!

I would take Alvarado again in a heartbeat! Overall he is just an amazing guy and he truly cares about his student's success. If you are struggling with homework he will do his best to extend deadlines and help guide you if you have any questions. If you do the homework and pay attention in class you'll do well in his class.

Really great guy I would take him again if given the choice. He is very kind and accessible outside of class. Do your homework and read the slides he posts and you will do well. He is really clear on his expectations, does his best to accommodate students. Really understanding I wish all professors were like him.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Alvarado is a solid choice, I'd never coded before and it is a steep learning curve. He'll work with you to ensure you understand the material and is understanding. He is tough but he rewards hard work and effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Ive never coded in my life and was very overwhelmed on my first day of class. I brought it up to him and he wanted to do everything he could so that I wouldnt feel overwhelmed. Hes very understanding and wants his students to pass. The exams are hard but I also really know nothing about coding. He responds to emails and encourages you all the time.

What a nice and caring professor! Will always make exceptions on hw or lab due dates if something comes up in your life. He is also very lenient on due dates and late work in general. Aside from the obvious semi difficult labs and exams, he really prepares you to succeed. It would be hard to fail this class. Please take him if you can!!!

Professor Alvarado is a Caring and compassionate person who genuinely cares about helping his students succeed. He puts his students before himself and wants to see everyone succeed. During my time with the professor, he noticed a lack of effort and engagement in the class. instead of letting it slide, he did what he could to pull us all back in.
